Method of Attack: Uninstalls Emotet malware from infected devices by deleting associated Windows services and autorun Registry key after April 25th, 2021 at 12:00
Before uninstall date, allows Emotet to be installed but redirects command and control servers to law enforcement controlled servers to prevent malicious activity
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected with Emotet malware
Attack Vector: Emotet botnet update mechanism pushing down the module to infected devices
Indicators of Compromise: Emotet botnet servers replaced with law enforcement controlled servers
Module named 'EmotetLoader.dll' pushed to infected devices
